promises.title: A removed caregiver loses access straight away
promises.why: Membership is re-checked on every request, so a removed person's open sign-in stops working at once.
caught: Strangers learn that a circle exists (403 instead of 404)

promises.title: Outsiders cannot tell whether a circle exists
promises.why: A stranger gets the same 'not found' for a real circle as for one that does not exist.
caught: Strangers learn that a circle exists (403 instead of 404)

promises.title: Private notes never reach a paid carer
promises.why: Family caregivers can mark a note private. A paid carer in the same circle must never see it.
caught: Private notes are shown to everyone

promises.title: The emergency link never shows private notes or private documents
promises.why: Anyone with the link can read it, so only shared information may appear.
caught: Private notes are shown to everyone
Private documents appear on the emergency link

promises.title: A switched-off emergency link stops working
promises.why: Revoking a shared link must cut access immediately.
caught: A switched-off emergency link still opens

promises.title: A scheduled dose can only be recorded once
promises.why: A second 'given' for the same dose is refused and says who already recorded it, so nobody double-doses.
caught: A dose can be recorded twice

promises.title: Reviewing a handoff never ticks off unfinished jobs
promises.why: Acknowledging means 'I have read this'. Open items stay open until someone records an outcome.
caught: Reviewing a handoff closes every open job

promises.title: Corrections keep the original entry and the reason
promises.why: Nothing is overwritten. Everyone can see what was first written, what changed, who changed it and why.
caught: A correction overwrites the original entry

promises.title: Shared costs always add up to the cent
promises.why: Splitting money must never lose or invent a cent, even when it does not divide evenly.
caught: Shared costs are rounded and gain a cent

promises.title: Signing out ends only this browser
promises.why: Signing out on the family tablet must not sign you out on your phone.
caught: Signing out signs out every browser (the original bug)

promises.title: A doctor or nurse can read but not change the record
promises.why: Clinician access is read-only and time-limited.
caught: Doctors and nurses can change the record

promises.title: Changing your password signs out every other browser
promises.why: If a phone is lost, a new password must end the sessions on it.
caught: A new password leaves a lost phone signed in
